# Reader opening regression

`legacy-opening.txt` is the unchanged first 800 characters of chapter one of
the user's existing novel `你那份我没动`, copied read-only on 2026-10-13.
The full manuscript SHA-256 is
`42646ec5920de3430f30ea93d59ba658584a0ace345d109b9666c6b5c6330200`.
The production manuscript and title were not modified.

The deterministic regression supplies a labelled provider double to verify
that an incomprehension result overrides a high literary score. It does not
claim the actual model or a human reader produced that mocked verdict.
Real-provider reports, including false positives and invalid reports, remain
in the isolated acceptance evidence.
